decision_order: R1 no_independent_evidence: group has < min_independent_members independently evidenced members -> not_selected
R3 class technique/reference or conversion not_portable -> reference_only(policy_reference_class)
R4 relation missing_in_native (no Platinum counterpart to replace) -> reference_only(no_native_target)

R5 class control: identical/content_match_native -> not_selected(identical_to_native); unmeasured -> reference_only(control_unmeasured); other -> reference_only(control_differs_from_native). Control is never selectable.
R6 class direct/convertible: gain 0 -> not_selected(identical_to_native); gain unmeasured -> reference_only(needs_evidence)

R7 direct/convertible: independent_share < selection_min_independent_share -> reference_only(weak_evidence_share); compat >= preferred_min_compat, risk <= preferred_max_risk, gain >= preferred_min_gain -> eligible_preferred; compat >= alternate_min_compat and gain >= alternate_min_gain -> eligible_alternate; else reference_only(below_integration_thresholds)
R8 per target: best eligible_preferred by ranking key becomes preferred; remaining eligible become alternate
R9 targets with no preferred resolve to platinum_native
description: Deterministic selection rules. The code in tools/visual_overhaul/selection/rules.py implements exactly these tables; validate_selection.py re-derives every decision from them.
